summary.root_cause_text: Order worker thread stalled: it was alive and sent heartbeats but stopped consuming the queue. The underlying reason for the stall is unknown. Config and recent deploys show nothing wrong.
recommended: Find out why the worker stalls: add worker-level logging and an alert on processed count not advancing, not only on heartbeat age
Add a watchdog that auto-restarts the worker when queue depth grows while processed stays flat
